verdict.rationale: Docusign markets configurable workflows (docs-4), a CLM drag-and-drop editor for designing contract processes (docs-17), and IAM workflow automation (docs-45, docs-12), and its SDK mentions approving documents (docs-13). Together these suggest contracts can be routed through designed processes, but none of the evidence explicitly describes pre-signature approval routing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of approval steps/approver routing before signature, configurable approval rules or conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
